segments.text: We first tried Cloud accounting in 208. At the time, market pressure mattered because manual reconciliation wasted staff time.
The biggest issue was FX volatility. Without steady power in Aba, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Cloud accounting—we saw Better cashflow visibility within 8 months.
Policy-wise, Import duty waivers shaped our move. We adjusted by Partnership with fintech.
Data helped; even a moving-average model gave us clearer demand patterns during Back-to-school.
